item.title: Nvidia targets $500B AI compute financing push
item.summary: Nvidia is teaming up with six of the world’s biggest investment groups to create financing platforms aimed at channeling more than $500 billion of third-party capital into AI infrastructure. The chipmaker has signed memorandums of understanding with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to develop independent financing vehicles for Nvidia-based compute infrastructure.
